faqs.question: What does 📌📌 mean on TikTok?
faqs.answer: On TikTok 📌📌 shows up as a comment-section reaction. The reaction register is universal across audiences.

faqs.question: What does 📌📌 mean from a stranger?
faqs.answer: From a stranger 📌📌 usually reads as a public-coded reaction. The combo is the same on comment sections regardless of relationship.

faqs.question: Does 📌📌 work in family chats?
faqs.answer: Yes — 📌📌 lands well in family chats when the recipient already understands reaction-coded cues.
